selectedMission.title: Operator Evidence Review and SCREENING-vs-DEEP Comparison
selectedMission.rationale: Current repository truth, HQ, roadmap, source, tests, and Missions 1-4 showed durable linked audit evidence but no operator comparison/disposition lane. The slice was useful, local-only, dependency-free, testable, and bounded to two sequential implementation scopes.

semanticFriction.finding: The planner artifacts recorded baselineTree a5f4fc4f... while Git proves commit 6b8790be... has tree 0ce0df1c....
semanticFriction.safetyImpact: Execution did not trust that value: coordinator binding overrides and every worker/integration preflight used the exact baseline commit and clean worktrees.
semanticFriction.followUp: Add semantic head-to-tree validation to the compact-capsule admission path before broader rollout.
